Run a full ad workflow with three agents
Three agents analyzed a landing page, researched the market and audience, and built the ads and copy.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The Reddit post describes a three-agent setup arranged like a small marketing team. One agent researched the market by looking at competitors, ads, keywords, and social posts; a second turned that research into positioning and campaign directions; and a third produced the ads, copy, and creative variations someone could potentially launch. The human role described here was mainly evaluating whether the output was actually strong enough to use.
How it went
The reported outcome was speed and tighter handoff between research, strategy, and creative, with the whole ad workflow said to run in minutes. But the post gives no performance numbers and explicitly questions whether the outputs are good enough yet for real ad results.
Worth knowing
The source is only a high-level Reddit post pointing to an external X post, so it does not provide reproducible setup details, costs, or measured results.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
Run three stages for my product [name] with landing page [URL]. First analyze the landing page's message and weaknesses, then research the market and target audience including competitors and pain points, then write [number] ad variations with headlines and copy for [platform]. Finish with one document containing all three outputs, and do not launch or spend on any ads.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/HowToAIAgent/comments/1rgw2ev/3_ai_agents_just_ran_a_full_ad_workflow_in
